name: Hotel Excelsior Dubrovnik
positioning: Seafront hotel 0.6 km from Dubrovnik Old Town, combining Villa Odak, a former royal villa dating from 1913, with the Tower and its sea-view suites
best_for: Travelers who want views of the walled Old Town and Lokrum island from their room
History lovers drawn to a former royal villa with a long list of famous guests
Couples looking for a suite with a balcony over the Adriatic coastline

facts.text: Villa Odak, the original part of the hotel, is a former early 20th century royal villa.
The Villa Odak Superior rooms were styled by top Croatian interior designers.
The Odak Suites were designed with inspiration from the 1913 origins of Villa Odak.
The Deluxe suite has floor-to-ceiling windows and a balcony with views of the Old Town and the Dalmatian coastline.
The Presidential Suite is on the top floor of the Tower part of the hotel.
The Executive Suites are individually designed and have sea views from the bed.
Deluxe rooms offer views of the garden island of Lokrum.
Superior rooms with partial sea view look out over the pine-draped coastline.
Abakus Piano Bar is open all year round and has live music as night falls.
Restaurant Salin serves an international buffet breakfast on a terrace overlooking the fortresses of the Old Town.

highlights.text: The individually designed Excelsior Signature suites offer views over the walled city of Dubrovnik from the bathtub.
Villa Odak, the original part of the hotel, dates from 1913, and its guest list has included the distinguished and the famous.
The hotel pays homage to its famous guests in a Gallery of Fame.
Prora, the hotel's signature a la carte restaurant, is set directly by the shore with views of Lokrum Island and the Old Town.

considerations.text: Dubrovnik Old Town is 0.6 km from the hotel rather than on its doorstep.
The hotel is 22.6 km from the airport.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing and that the historic building may have smaller room layouts.
